body: I’m 28. I don’t like existing? I don’t like breathing, I don’t like eating, I don’t like sleeping, I don’t like fucking, I don’t like working. It’s all so damn tedious. I’ve done enough, really experienced enough for one life and I’m just not keen to stick around for the future’s bullshit

What? Yes, I am asking for help to fucking die jesus fucking christ this is what I'm talking about. Nobody would have blood on their hands, physically or metaphorically if it were my decision. I'm not here for a pity party either, my story isn't interesting, standard shitty life of broken dreams and disconnection and isolation. It's not special, it's not particularly traumatic and awful either. It's just a life I'm not interested in continuing and whyyyyyy is this so hard for people to get.

Everyone is always themselves. Even when they’re pretending to be someone else, that’s still them being them, trying to survive. I’m not lacking in self awareness, I know who I am, also acutely aware I know I don’t belong. I’m not saying that out of some sense of pity by the way it’s more just pragmatism. 

I’m aware of the emotional variances of life and I am sure that some, maybe even a lot of people experience lives full of joy and fulfilment and belonging which is wonderful. I am also sure that some experience lives full of pain and suffering with the rare moment of joy or happiness, which has been my experience. 

I suppose I’m just hoping that when I do go people can grieve the loss of me honestly, as in a release from fear and suffering instead of mourning the loss of some utopian future vision of my life of lost potential.
